basics.summary: Final-year PhD candidate at the University of Edinburgh researching retrieval-augmented generation, model memory, multi-hop reasoning, and language agents.

work.name: Microsoft Research Cambridge
work.summary: Worked with John Winn on memory-augmented language modeling and the parameter efficiency of external factual memory.

work.summary: Researched reinforcement learning for language-model agents.
